```lean
intro x
let S := LieSubalgebra.engel K x
have hS : LieSubalgebra K S := by apply LieSubalgebra.mk
let f := LinearMap.charpoly (LieAlgebra.ad K L x)
have hf : f = LinearMap.charpoly (LinearMap.mulLeft (LinearMap.ofEq (LieAlgebra.ad K L x))) := by rfl
let g := LinearMap.charpoly (LinearMap.mulLeft (LinearMap.ofEq (LieAlgebra.ad K L x)))
have hg : g = f := by rfl
let m := Module.finrank K ↥S
let n := (LinearMap.charpoly ((LieAlgebra.ad K L) x)).natTrailingDegree
have h1 : m = n :=
  by
    rw [hg]
    rw [g]
    rw [hf]
    rw [f]
    have h2 : Module.finrank K ↥S = (LinearMap.charpoly (LieAlgebra.ad K L x)).natTrailingDegree :=
      by
        apply Module.finrank_eq_natTrailingDegree
        apply LieSubalgebra.isEngel
        apply LieSubalgebra.isEngel'
        apply LieAlgebra.ad_is_endomorphism
        apply LieAlgebra.ad_is_linear
        apply LieAlgebra.ad_is_endomorphism
        apply LieAlgebra.ad_is_linear
        apply Module.Finite K L
    exact h2
exact h1
```
